Hi Soojin — thanks for the notes and the SOC snapshot. Procurement's intake is gating any onsite or recorded demo at the moment. They require the completed vendor questionnaire and a completed supplier risk assessment before we can move forward with an in-person pilot.

Quick summary of the blockers:
- The vendor questionnaire (attached link) needs the product's data retention and encryption specifics filled out.
- They want a one-page data flow diagram and confirmation of whether Redwood stores PHI or only processes tokens transiently.
- A recent SOC2 snapshot is great — Procurement needs the control owner contact and the document date on the cover page.

Tom (Ops) is traveling next week and had asked if we could keep the demo virtual if Procurement will accept a virtual walkthrough while their portal intake completes.

Can your security lead provide the data flow sketch and a cover page update to the SOC2 snapshot? If so we can keep the demo next week but switch to virtual. Otherwise we need to pause scheduling until the portal intake is greenlit.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Technical Programs | Cypress Health

Jonas / Marissa — fyi, Cypress Procurement is gating the in-person demo until the portal questionnaire and supplier risk items are completed. They indicated a virtual demo would be acceptable while the intake is underway, provided we can deliver a couple artifacts quickly: a one-page data flow diagram and a dated SOC2 cover page with control owner.

Can either of you pull a one-page data flow (redacted) and a 1-paragraph control owner blurb by end of day Thursday? I can propose a virtual slot for next Wed if we have those.

Thanks — Soojin
